entry.summary: No visa for tourists up to 90 days.
entry.other: Entering on an emergency passport needs a visa first.

money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The official currency of Botswana is the Pula (BWP). You must declare any foreign currency that's over the equivalent value of Pula 10,000 when you enter and leave Botswana.

consular.mission: Australian Consulate, Gaborone; Australian High Commission, Pretoria
consular.notes: There is an Australian Consulate in Botswana, which provides limited consular and passport assistance. The Australian High Commission in Pretoria, South Africa, can also provide consular assistance to Australians in Botswana.

sources.title: Botswana travel advice: consular contacts
sources.supports: the Australian offices that give consular help

conditional: Yellow fever vaccination certificate if arriving from (or transiting) a country with yellow fever risk
health-entry.notes: Australia asks for a yellow fever certificate when you return from a country with yellow fever risk.

laws.rule: Penalties for drug offences are severe and include mandatory jail sentences. This includes offences involving marijuana (cannabis).
laws.heading: Drugs

laws.rule: Serious offences, including murder and treason, carry the death penalty.
laws.heading: Death penalty

laws.rule: Exporting elephant hair, ivory, and rhinoceros horn products is illegal. If you want to export animal souvenirs or 'trophies', you need either: a government permit a receipt from a licensed store You must not observe wildlife closer than the minimum legal distance.
laws.heading: Wildlife laws

laws.rule: Some crimes, such as serious assaults, attract physical punishment. It's illegal to: possess pornography take photos of military or government installations
laws.heading: Other crimes
